description: Keep this app on the latest keel tag automatically. Scoped to keel only — a custom regex manager bumps both the requirements.txt pin and the reusable-workflow pin in .github/workflows/, then auto-merges once this repo's own CI is green.

packageRules.description: Group both keel pins (requirements + workflow) into one PR. Renovate merges it itself once this repo's CI is green. platformAutomerge is OFF on purpose: these are private repos on a free plan with no branch protection, so GitHub-native auto-merge would merge before CI runs. Renovate's own automerge waits for green checks (ignoreTests defaults false).
